reconfigure.description: Change the address or the login of your Enet Smart Home server.

data_description.url: Address of the Enet Smart Home server, for example http://192.168.1.10. Use https:// if the server is set up for it.
data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The Enet Smart Home server at {url} rejected the login. Enter the username and password again.

data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

abort.discovery_not_supported: An Enet Smart Home server was discovered, but setting it up from discovery is not supported yet. Please add the integration manually.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Stores the current state of every light, switch and cover of the scene in the scene on the Enet server.

set_scene_level.name: Set scene level
set_scene_level.description: Changes the level of one member of the scene on the Enet server.

member.name: Member
member.description: Light, switch or cover of the scene to change.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness of a dimmer in the scene, 0 is off.

state.name: State
state.description: On or off, for switches and lights.

position.name: Position
position.description: Position of a cover in the scene, 100 is open.

tilt_position.name: Tilt position
tilt_position.description: Tilt position of a blind in the scene, 100 is open.

add_scene_member.name: Add scene member
add_scene_member.description: Adds a light, switch or cover to the scene on the Enet server, at the given level or at its current state.

member.name: Member
member.description: Light, switch or cover to add to the scene.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness of a dimmer in the scene, 0 is off. Leave out to use the current state.

state.name: State
state.description: On or off, for switches and lights. Leave out to use the current state.

position.name: Position
position.description: Position of a cover in the scene, 100 is open. Leave out to use the current state.

tilt_position.name: Tilt position
tilt_position.description: Tilt position of a blind in the scene, 100 is open. Leave out to use the current state.

remove_scene_member.name: Remove scene member
remove_scene_member.description: Removes a light, switch or cover from the scene on the Enet server.

member.name: Member
member.description: Light, switch or cover to remove from the scene.

create_scene.name: Create scene
create_scene.description: Creates a scene on the Enet server with lights, switches and covers at their current state. The scene is shown in the Enet app as well.

members.name: Members
members.description: Lights, switches and covers of the scene. They are stored at their current state.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon of the scene in the Enet app.

config_entry_id.name: Enet server
config_entry_id.description: The Enet server to create the scene on. Only needed with more than one.

delete_scene.name: Delete scene
delete_scene.description: Deletes the scene on the Enet server. It is gone from the Enet app and the scene buttons as well.

data.scene_editor: Edit Enet scenes in the scene editor

data_description.scene_editor: Make the scenes of the Enet server Home Assistant scenes (in scenes.yaml), to edit them in the scene editor, and give every Home Assistant scene with Enet lights a scene on the Enet server for the scene buttons and the Enet app. Changes on either side are synced.
data_description.location_scenes: Also add the scenes the Enet server makes for each room, each floor and the whole home, which switch all their lights on or off. Scenes made in the Enet app are always added.

scene_editor_off.title: Scenes in the scene editor
scene_editor_off.description: {count} scenes in the scene editor were made from the scenes of the Enet server. Without the option they are not synced anymore. Kept, they are ordinary Home Assistant scenes, next to the scenes of the integration with the same names. Deleted, the integration's scenes come back with their entity ids. The scenes on the Enet server are not changed.

options.keep: Keep them as Home Assistant scenes
options.delete: Delete them from the scene editor

leftover_scenes.title: Scenes left behind by the Enet integration

init.title: Scenes left behind by the Enet integration
init.description: {title} was removed. {count} scenes in the scene editor were made from the scenes of its Enet server and are not synced anymore. Choose whether to keep them as ordinary Home Assistant scenes or delete them. The scenes on the Enet server are not changed. If you add the integration again, they are linked to the Enet scenes again.
